```{python}
from collections import OrderedDict
from pathlib import Path
import html
import yaml
from IPython.display import Markdown

candidates = [
    Path("pages/Teaching/data/mentoring.yml"),
    Path("data/mentoring.yml"),
    Path("mentoring.yml"),
]
mentoring_file = next((p for p in candidates if p.exists()), None)
if mentoring_file is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError("mentoring.yml not found")

with mentoring_file.open(encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    projects = yaml.safe_load(fh) or []


def escape(value):
    return html.escape(str(value)) if value is not None else ""


projects_by_year = OrderedDict()
for project in projects:
    year = str(project.get("year", "Unknown")).strip() or "Unknown"
    projects_by_year.setdefault(year, []).append(project)

lines = ['<div class="teaching-container">', '<div class="teaching-list teaching-section">']

for year, entries in projects_by_year.items():
    for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
        year_label = escape(year) if index == 0 else ""
        program = escape(entry.get("program", ""))
        program_url = str(entry.get("program_url", "")).strip()
        topics = escape(entry.get("topics", ""))
        topics_url = str(entry.get("topics_url", "")).strip()
        mentees = [escape(name) for name in (entry.get("mentees") or [])]
        poster_url = str(entry.get("poster_url", "")).strip()

        if program_url:
            program_html = f'<a href="{escape(program_url)}">{program}</a>'
        else:
            program_html = program

        if topics and topics_url:
            topics_html = f'<a href="{escape(topics_url)}">{topics}</a>'
        else:
            topics_html = topics

        mentees_html = ", ".join(mentees) if mentees else "TBD"

        lines.append("<li>")
        lines.append(f'<div class="teaching-year">{year_label}</div>')
        lines.append('<div class="course-entry">')
        lines.append(program_html)
        lines.append('<div class="course-meta">')
        if topics_html:
            lines.append(f"**Topics**: {topics_html}<br>")
        lines.append(f"**Mentees**: {mentees_html}<br>")
        if poster_url:
            lines.append(f'[**Project Poster**]({escape(poster_url)})<br>')
        lines.append("</div>")
        lines.append("</div>")
        lines.append("</li>")

lines.append("</div>")
lines.append("</div>")

Markdown("\n".join(lines))
```
